tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The OTECH 2U 19in X26RM Heavy-Duty Silver Black Rack Mount Case is a professional-grade server chassis designed for high-performance IT infrastructure, data centers, and enterprise networking environments. Built with industrial-grade heavy-duty steel, this 2U rackmount case ensures long-lasting durability ,stability, and reliable performance under continuous operation.


Designed to fit standard 19-inch racks, the X26RM provides a space-efficient solution for server builds, MikroTik systems, NAS, NVR, and firewall applications. Its optimized internal layout supports multiple storage drives, efficient airflow, and flexible hardware installation, making it ideal for modern server and networking deployments.


With a sleek silver and black industrial finish, front I/O ports, and easy access design, the OTECH X26RM delivers both performance and professional aesthetics for IT professionals in Bangladesh.


Key Features


  • Standard 2U rackmount design for 19-inch racks
  • Heavy-duty steel construction for durability
  • Silver & black industrial finish
  • Supports Micro-ATX / Mini-ITX motherboards
  • Multiple HDD/SSD installation support
  • Efficient cooling system with fan support
  • Front USB ports, Power & Reset buttons
  • Ideal for server, NAS, NVR, firewall, and networking systems
